# A) legacy default mode
20008 1A 4 FF 00 00 00
sleep 6000
20008 2D 128 00 00 00 00
# B) fan max on (louder, safe) then off
20008 27 4 01 00 00 00
sleep 6000
20008 2D 128 00 00 00 00
20008 27 4 00 00 00 00
sleep 8000
20008 2D 128 00 00 00 00
# C) mode 0x31 then 0x30
20008 1A 4 FF 31 00 00
sleep 6000
20008 2D 128 00 00 00 00
20008 1A 4 FF 30 00 00
sleep 8000
20008 2D 128 00 00 00 00
